paragraphs: Incorporated 2020, Eventions Limited is engaged in providing event management and experiential marketing services. It specializes in planning and executing corporate events, brand activations, exhibitions, conferences, and promotional campaigns.

The company offers end-to-end solutions, including event conceptualization, design, logistics, and on-ground execution. It caters to corporate clients across various industries, helping them enhance brand visibility and customer engagement through customized event experiences.
Eventions Private Limited focuses on creativity, timely execution, and client-centric solutions, aiming to deliver impactful and memorable events.
The company has undertaken assignments for clients operating across various sectors including banking, insurance, event management, fast-moving consumer goods and other industry.

faqs.question: How to apply in Eventions IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Eventions IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Eventions IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Eventions IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Eventions IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Eventions IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Eventions IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
